subject: Action: lock demo window — introduce security & procurement owners
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@finlytics.com>, Leah Burns <leah.burns@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Action: lock demo window — introduce security & procurement owners

Thanks for a productive discovery today — quick recap and next steps.

Recap (2 min):
- Finlytics is focused on reducing per-token inference cost for large batch scoring and enabling a low-latency retrieval pipeline for the fraud detection use case.
- Key constraints: SSO + strict audit logging, quarterly contract cadence, and procurement approval required for PoC spend over $50k.

Proposed next step: 45–60m technical deep-dive + sandbox demo to validate throughput and SSO flow. Please confirm who from your security and procurement teams should join so we can have the right owners on the call.

Times we have available (Pacific):
1) Thu Dec 4, 11:00–12:00 PT
2) Thu Dec 4, 15:00–15:45 PT
3) Mon Dec 8, 09:00–10:00 PT

Can you confirm (a) which slot works, (b) the names/emails of the security/procurement contacts we should loop in, and (c) any hard blockers (e.g., air-gapped requirements)?

Attaching: Finlytics_Security_Checklist_v1.pdf and a draft agenda (Proposed_demo_agenda.docx). I cc Marissa (platform specialist) and Mina (solutions engineer) — we will lead the demo and cover deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private).

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0173
Redwood Inference

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@finlytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Burns <leah.burns@finlytics.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Action: lock demo window — introduce security & procurement owners

Thanks Vivek — great session today.

We can do Thu Dec 4 at 15:00 PT (option 2) — Leah will be the security lead attending. For procurement, please loop in Gabe Rivera (ecosys-partners) — he manages third-party contracts for our infra purchases and will advise on the PoC spend path.

Gabe's email: gabe.rivera@ecosys-partners.com

A few notes from our side:
- We do require SAML SSO (Okta) and an audit-log export for every call.
- If the PoC shows expected gains we will look to move to a quarterly committed tier; initial commitment conversation would start after PoC readout.

On the agenda, please spend 10–15 mins on integration/SSO and 20 mins on throughput/latency numbers — Mina's sandbox walkthrough will be helpful.

Appreciate you attaching the checklist — I'll review and flag any gaps before tomorrow.

—Amit
Amit Shah
Director, Data Platforms | Finlytics
amit.shah@finlytics.com

Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Action: lock demo window — introduce security & procurement owners

Looping Gabe in — thanks for joining this thread, Gabe. Per Amit, procurement will want a clear PoC spend path and an initial SOW estimate. Marissa, can you own procurement/contract questions on our side? Mina will cover the sandbox and SSO flow.

Gabe — quick context: Finlytics is evaluating Redwood to reduce inference cost and support a low-latency retrieval scoring pipeline. Their security team (Leah) requires Okta SAML + audit logs; procurement wants pricing/PoC approvals for >$50k.

I've attached the draft agenda (Proposed_demo_agenda.docx) — suggested breakdown: 5m intros, 15m SSO/integration, 20m sandbox throughput tests, 10m procurement/next steps.

Requesting:
- Gabe: the procurement checklist you use (or a sample SOW template) so we can prefill and accelerate approvals.
- Leah: any must-have SSO tests we should run in the sandbox (e.g., SAML assertion mapping, user provisioning).
- Marissa: confirm who owns contract sign-off and whether we should route to legal or channel procurement first.

I'll hold the 15:00 PT slot tentatively (calendar stub: https://cal.redwood.ai/meet/vivek/finlytics-demo-1). If we need the earlier slot I can swap.

Thanks — Vivek

15:00 PT works for me — confirmed and calendar invite received.

Quick SSO notes for the agenda: please include a short test that demonstrates SAML attribute mapping for the following groups: analyst, ops, admin. We also need the sandbox to produce an exportable audit log (JSON/CSV) for a 24h session. If you can show a sample audit export that would answer most of our questions.

Attached: SSO_requirements_summary.pdf (short checklist). Gabe — happy to review a draft SOW if you want me to flag security items up front.

See you tomorrow — Leah
